name: usle_tillage_conventional
source: OMAFRA factsheet 23-005, Table 5, Fall plow; reading conventional tillage as full-width fall tillage is this work's

name: usle_tillage_strip_till_row
source: OMAFRA Table 5, Zone tillage

name: usle_tillage_strip_till_drilled
source: OMAFRA Table 5, Mulch tillage (the reduced-tillage system of drilled crops: disk and drill)

name: usle_tillage_no_till
source: OMAFRA Table 5, No-till

name: usle_cover_crop_factor
source: Middle of 0.01-0.10 for a rye cover in research/crop_coefficients.csv, itself unverified

name: usle_metric
source: OMAFRA factsheet 23-005: A = 2.24 x R x K x LS x C x P

name: slope_length_m
source: Assumption: the slope length of the field is not known

name: erosive_rain_mm
source: Days with at least half an inch of rain carry the erosive rain (USLE convention, recalled)

name: killing_frost_c
source: 28 F, the usual killing-freeze threshold for corn and soybeans (recalled)

name: frost_from_doy
source: Autumn frosts are counted from 1 August

name: mature_share_required
source: Assumption: a planting date is offered only where the crop matured before the frost in this share of the years

name: plant_early_days
source: Assumption: planting is offered from two weeks before the state's median planting day, with no yield credit for being early

name: kc_stage_shares
source: Initial, development, mid and late stage as shares of planting to maturity, after the FAO-56 maize lengths 30/40/50/30 days; used for every crop

name: alfalfa_season_end_doy
source: Assumption: the last cutting is done by 1 October

name: alfalfa_seed_late_days
source: Assumption: spring seeding is offered until four weeks after the state's median oat planting day

name: rye_first_doy
source: Assumption: a rye cover is seeded from 15 August

name: rye_last_doy
source: Penn State Extension, Cereal rye as a cover crop: optimum seeding September to late October

name: rye_cleared_doy
source: Assumption: a rye cover that no crop was planted into is gone by 1 July

name: plant_late_days_without_response
source: Assumption: a crop with no planting-date trial in data/planting_date_response.csv is offered until three weeks after the state's median planting day, at full yield

name: usle_crop_factor_hay_pasture
source: OMAFRA factsheet 23-005, Table 4A: hay and pasture; used for a hay or pasture crop in the history that is not planned here

name: usle_crop_factor_unlisted
source: Assumption: any other crop in the history that is not planned here leaves the ground as grain corn does (OMAFRA factsheet 23-005, Table 4A)

name: organic_soil_om_pct
source: Assumption: above this organic matter in the surface layer the soil is treated as organic and the mineral-soil carbon model is not applied

name: rotation_min_relative_yield
source: Assumption: the field's own rotation is planted late only while the trials keep three quarters of the yield; later it waits for the crop's next season

name: erosive_share_before_planting
source: Assumption: the share of the year's erosive rain that falls between harvest and planting, which a cover crop protects; not read for any field

name: season_share_of_annual_rain
source: Assumption: April-October rain as a share of the year's, about Iowa's; the season summaries hold only those months. Lower in the Southeast and on the Pacific coast
